# ECLYRIA — Quaternius Asset Credits

The visual pipeline uses real Quaternius assets. The official pack pages state CC0 licensing for the packs used below.

## Characters

### Universal Base Characters
- Active mesh: `static_characters/EclyriaHero_static.glb`
- Source model: Quaternius Universal Base Characters
- Official: https://quaternius.com/packs/universalbasecharacters.html
- License: CC0
- Processing: skeletal skin/animation data stripped from the embedded source GLB to create a stable mesh-only Godot asset.

- Active meshes:

- Creator: Quaternius
